authority_rule: Drive boards preserve design lineage and review reasoning. Repository law remains authoritative; intermediate boards are not equal final UI authority.

accepted_boundary.global_shell: Wireframe 01R structural baseline; do not reopen without a demonstrated functional defect.
accepted_boundary.production_home: resume/current-situation first; other Productions subordinate; exact imagery and labels provisional.
accepted_boundary.production_shaping: situation-first; follow meaning into contextual/deep inspection rather than category-first database navigation.
accepted_boundary.component_coverage: whole-Production Character management, truth/knowledge/disclosure inspection, persistence/recovery status and Production-level utilities all have reserved homes.
accepted_boundary.next: interaction/state stress testing; stop layout redraws.

interaction_test_minimum: Character select -> inspector -> deep inspection/edit -> return/focus restoration
unresolved question -> adjacent cause -> expanded history -> return to visibly current Scene
whole-Production Character access -> off-Scene edit -> return without changing current Scene semantics
persistence/recovery exception -> truthful recovery flow -> prior task restored
unavailable provider/capability -> blocked action -> explanation/alternative/return without fictional behavior
wide/medium/narrow adaptation -> overlay/sequential inspection -> same semantic target and focus restored
phase2_gate: CLOSED until Phase 1 exit criteria pass and Engineering/Product authority is fresh-reconciled.
separate_continuity_issue: Recovered historical intake cloud preservation remains independently unresolved; the new Phase-1 archive preserves this chat's generated boards and reasoning but does not prove all older intake binaries are synced.
